local_note: Follows and saves stay on this console.
storage_error: Could not save. Check SD card storage.
invalid_link: Enter a TikTok video link or @username.
public_error: TikTok did not respond. Check your connection and retry.
public_blocked: TikTok did not provide this content. It may be private, region restricted or require verification.
profile_empty: Profile found; TikTok did not provide a video list. Paste a video link to watch.
stream_unavailable: No native playable stream was provided. Photo posts are not supported.
own_empty: No accessible public videos found on your account.
following_note: This list is local; it does not sync with your TikTok follows.
no_follows: Choose Follow locally while watching a video or viewing a profile.
saved_note: Videos saved on this console to watch later.
history_note: Videos opened on this console. Does not sync with TikTok account history.
home_note: Paste a video link or open a profile with @username. TikTok does not provide your personal For You feed to this client.
paste_hint: Enter a TikTok link or @username in the field above.
playback_error: Playback failed. The link may have expired or TikTok may have restricted access.
account_note: Scan the QR code with TikTok on your phone and authorize access. Login connects your profile and own public videos; it does not grant access to For You, account follows or likes.
client_needed: Developer settings below are required for QR login.
qr_confirm: Code scanned. Confirm the TikTok authorization on your phone.
qr_scan: Scan using TikTok → Search → QR scanner. Refresh the code after 3 minutes.
qr_too_large: TikTok link exceeds QR capacity. Cancel login and retry.
login_error: Login failed; check settings and retry.
client_invalid: Client Key, Client Secret and a valid HTTPS Redirect URI are required.
client_help: TikTok Developer Portal: Login Kit + Display API with user.info.basic and video.list. Redirect URI must match the registered address. Credentials are not shipped with the app.
